patches.title: Phasmophobia Quality of Life Part 2 Preview
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more.Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upcoming second Quality of Life update for Phasmophobia. We’ll be releasing this update across all platforms on 25th August, 2026. Exact release times are still to be confirmed, so keep an eye on our channels for official confirmation of when the update is live. Let’s break down a couple of the features we’re excited about before sharing the full list: New Restricted OptionsFor a long while, we have seen folks requesting smaller versions of our larger maps in the vein of Sunny Meadows Restricted. With this update we’re excited to introduce Restricted versions for Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.As with Sunny Meadows, these map variants are designed for quicker games in locations that we know players enjoy but sometimes don’t want to be investigating the larger area. In the case of Point Hope Restricted, which will be classed as small, Ghost Hunters will be able to access up to the Dining Room while Prison and Brownstone High School will have multiple variants - classed as Small and Medium respectively - which will be randomly assigned upon loading into a contract. Brownstone High School in particular will have a total of 4 map variants following the update. With such a big map, we believed it was appropriate to give a variety of variations, giving Ghost Hunters a sense of mystery when loading up. Outside each Restricted version of the map, a small piece of environmental decor will signify which variant of the map you’re on. Journal & Evidence ChangesWe made a handful of changes and improvements to Evidence collection with the first Quality of Life update, and we’re doing the same with the second. As with all of our updates, we’ll be looking for and reading through player feedback on these changes so please do let us know your thoughts once you’ve spent some time with them. Since our Chronicle update last year, we’ve been working on finessing the Unique/Duplicate system. A change we’re introducing with this next update...

patches.title: Phasmophobia v0.18.0.1 - Hotfix
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We've deployed a small hotfix to address feedback on the Equipment and Item slot assignments. Patch notes below: ChangesItems and Equipment will now be assigned a slot in the order they are picked up from 1-3. Flashlights will no longer be locked to 1. Igniters will default to 4.

patches.title: Phasmophobia v0.18.0.1 - Patch Notes
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Today we have deployed an update for Phasmophobia that addresses several issues that were raised following last week’s update. Thank you to everyone who provided feedback and helped us identify these issues.Full patch notes below. FixesFixed an issue that caused Photo Cameras to interfere with other player animations.Fixed an issue that caused the Photo Camera’s Use animation to not play in Multiplayer.Fixed an issue that caused the Photo Camera to take an extra photo when dropped while taking a photo.Fixed an issue that caused the Photo Camera to take a photo if picked up by another player after being dropped while being used by the original player.Fixed an issue that caused Twitch Drop reward ID Card & Badge cosmetics to be missing.Fixed an issue that would cause items to get stuck or fall through the floor when dropped in Multiplayer.Fixed an issue that caused videos of a Hunting Ghost to not count towards the Apocalypse challenge.Fixed an issue that allowed Ghosts to be able to enter several hiding spots in 13 Willow Street.This also fixes similar issues in 6 Tanglewood Drive, 42 Edgefield Road and 10 Ridgeview Court.Fixed an issue that caused the Incense to not appear as Used if the animation was cancelled by opening the Journal.VR - Fixed an issue that caused unstable FPS whilst in the Truck.VR - Fixed an issue that caused players to become stuck while loading in to a Multiplayer game on Bleasdale Farmhouse.Known IssuesIf a Flashlight is not picked up, hotkeys are assigned in this order: 2, 3, 1. If a Flashlight is picked up, it will default to 1. A following patch will address this issue, with Equipment being assigned in the order they are picked up. Igniters will however always default to 4.

patches.title: Phasmophobia v0.18.0.0 - 13 Willow Street Rework & Quality of Life #1
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Today we have released Phasmophobia v0.18.0.0, our latest update that brings our reworked 13 Willow Street map as well as our first Quality of Life update for 2026. Patch notes can be found below. New13 Willow Street Rework: The map has received a full visual overhaul, with new assets, props and more available to discover during your contracts. The original layout remains, however some rooms have been repurposed and the flow of several rooms has been edited to improve gameplay.Adding keybinds for Equipment slots. Players can rebind this via Options > Controls.A separate Photo can now be taken capturing a EMF Level 5 reading.Photo Cameras will now feature the same highlight frame as Video Cameras. On screen indicator only on Tier 2 and 3 Photo Cameras, while Tier 1 will have the light change colour from red to green.When capturing Media, if multiple are present, the evidence that provides the biggest reward or is Unique will be prioritised.New Ghost: the Deildegast Players will have a higher chance of getting this Ghost in their contracts for the first few weeks following release.Added new walking animations and turning animations to fix several issues:Character legs will no longer use procedural IK and will instead use animations.The character body will no longer animate with the walking animations which caused held items to move while walking.Improvements to the overall VR character:New character animations.Improvements to the belt to improve usability.The character will now turn instantly depending on where you are looking instead of at set angles. Read the below for some details on these additions.Adding keybinds for Equipment slots. PC players will be able to switch Equipment with the 1, 2, 3 and 4 keys. These keys can be rebound. patches.title: Phasmophobia Quality of Life Update Preview
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.Today we’re going to give you more detail on the upcoming Quality of Life update launching alongside the 13 Willow Street rework on July 21st, 2026.As mentioned in our recent blogpost, the Quality of Life update itself has been split into two due to the sheer number of fixes & improvements we’ll be implementing. This first update is the bigger of the two, but you can expect the second part in late August.The below list focuses on changes and fixes coming with this month’s update while the next update will contain further improvements.While there’s a lot in the below list, it’s not everything that’ll be launching for Phasmophobia on July 21st, with the update bringing with it new keybinds, including PC players being able to use 1, 2, 3 and 4 for changing inventory slots, a couple of improvements for evidence collection and of course, the reworked 13 Willow Street. We’ll detail all of these in a blog the week before launch.ChangesThe character hand animations for grabbing, dropping, moving doors and hovering over interactable or grabbable objects have been removed to speed up gameplay.The item drop animation will still play for others in the session, but will not be visible by the Player.Cosmetics that are no longer able to be earned will not be visible.The camera zoom in the Customisation shop will now focus on the selected part of the character.On Sunny Meadows, the Ghost will now only lock the doors to a wing if both it and a player are inside that wing.Eye Adaptation will now adjust the lighting quicker when opening and closing the Journal.Console players will now have the ability to enable/disable Eye Adaptation.The Obake’s shapeshift will now count towards the Ghost video objective.You can now capture any Media for the Apocalypse challenge, instead of only a photo.Recording the Ghost Orbs in the Tutorial is now required, instead of only getting it inside the video camera’s screen.Improved the lighting around the player, allowing for better visibility in darker areas.Added an icon to the Player ID Card to show if that player is speaking.Adjusted the visuals on the PSVR2 player list popupEvent board map leaflets are now spread over ...

patches.title: Phasmophobia 2026 and Beyond
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Over the last month and a half, we’ve been reading the discussions about Phasmophobia across so many different channels and taking note of the biggest issues, points of concern, questions and more. We are sorry it’s taken a while to respond, but we wanted to make sure that when we did, we had something of substance for you. Hopefully today, with our updated Roadmap and information on what’s to come to Phasmophobia, we can start to build back your trust and have meaningful conversations around the game we all care so deeply about.We’ll go in to more detail on everything in this blog, but for those of you that would rather just have the headlines, here we go:The rework of 13 Willow Street will launch July 21st, 2026 alongside a Quality of Life update.A further Quality of Life update will launch in August 2026.Our upgrade to Unity 6 will take place in October 2026.An additional Player Character update will launch in November, bringing with it improved animations, character models, UI, more clothing and customisation options.Phasmophobia 1.0, as well as our next new map, will now launch in 2027. A New RoadmapOver the last month, we’ve taken a look at our plans for 2026 and made important decisions and changes to make sure we get things right. Phasmophobia’s new Roadmap, which can be seen below, focuses on bringing the game back in-line with our vision and one that we hope reignites your passion for it. With a focus on quality of life over new content, our various updates will bring with them hundreds of fixes - starting with our first update in July - as well as bringing the game up- to-date with Unity 6. Our second Player Character update will improve and redo areas such as the animations, character models, UI and introduce a host of new customisation options.Alongside these various updates, you can expect to see more regular Development Previews that’ll take you deeper into what they’ll contain and the improvements they’ll bring to Phasmophobia.You may notice that a few things have been removed from the Roadmap for 2026, such as Phasmophobia 1.0 and our new map. patches.title: Phasmophobia - Hotfix v0.17.1.5
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.Today we have released a hotfix for Phasmophobia, addressing two issues raised by the community this week. The update is now available across all platforms.Patch notes:Fixed an issue that caused players to become softlocked when using the Spirit Box while using a controller. Fixed an issue for Steam players that caused Voice Recognition to not work. If you are encountering issues with Voice Recognition on the "Voice" setting on PC, please ensure that the default microphone assigned on your PC is the microphone specified in your windows settings.

patches.title: Phasmophobia v0.17.1.4 - Patch Notes
patches.content: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.Today we have released our latest update for Phasmophobia, addressing several known issues in the game.We are aware of the current ongoing issues in-game and are currently implementing fixes and improvements in future updates for Phasmophobia. We’ll be sharing our plans for the rest of 2026 later this month with you all, including a timeline for fixes and updates related to both the Player Character Update and game in general. In the meantime, please continue to provide feedback and bug reports so that our team can investigate as much as possible. You can submit any and all issues via our Support Centre.NewThe VR belt has been reimplemented following player feedback. Players will now also be able to switch between having their Journal and Walkie Talkie on the belt or their shoulder. The VR belt will only be visible locally, players who are looking at a VR player will see the equipment on their body instead.ChangesThe line of sight ghost speed accelerations implemented in the Player Character Update have been reverted to their original state.FixesFixed an issue that caused players to become softlocked when using the Spirit Box before interacting with the Truck’s CCTV.Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to kill players through floors.Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to kill players outside.Fixed an issue that caused the Tier 3 Firelight to not work correctly if placed while lit.Fixed an issue where player jackets would appear incorrectly when loading into a Multiplayer lobby.Fixed an issue where pressing ‘Join’ in Multiplayer without having a code entered would cause issues creating lobbies, and remove audio from the game.Fixed an issue where VR players were unable to use Text Input for the Spirit Box, Monkey Paw and Ouija Board.Known IssuesPlayers across all platforms are experiencing issues with voice recognition/voice chat. A fix is being investigated.Please note: Following this update, players on Windows 7/8 or other out-of-date Windows installs may need to run Windows Update (and restart) for voice chat to connect. This is due to a recent security certificate update on our voice servers. More info can be found here.As you ...

patches.title: Phasmophobia - Double XP & Rewards
patches.content: Ghost Hunters, Between May 22nd, 2026 and May 25th, 2026 you will receive double XP and rewards for any contracts you complete in Phasmophobia. We hope you enjoy.
